notes.title: V1.0.2 Update!
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 Released


This small update includes the following:

Added display size options to the settings menu: Large (window 3x), Medium (window 2x), and Small (window 1x).

Fixed a bug causing the game to freeze.

Fixed a bug where the letter "E" would sometimes disappear during the "Sacrifice Villager" tutorial.

Corrected several typos in various texts.
[hr][/hr]
We've recorded all your feedback and are discussing how to implement or optimize it. Your suggestions are what drive our progress—thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update V0.9!
notes.content:
Skills
Skill Casting: No more automatic targeting! You now personally choose where your skills are unleashed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/e6e4bfb62107bd512da7d3ccb3fc5770a7e7de74.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/0ecd2b0eeda8f0918837e55f1f36a5b0e444a4cb.gif"]

Skill Types: We've expanded your active skill slots to two! Your skill bar now includes Passive Skill, Active Skill 1, Active Skill 2, and Sacrifice Skill.

We've also refined the visuals and balanced the numbers for several skills.
UI
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/885ec4d806587674be3726a13901d3fef94267cc.jpg"]

Building Interaction: The UI for interacting with buildings is now much clearer and easier to understand.

Battlefield Overview: You can now directly see your villagers' status (alive or fallen) right from the battlefield interface.

We've added a new Battlefield Information Reminder Window to keep you informed.
Troops
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/ca667f20bad302dc8f52efadf132191d57d461fe.jpg"]

Simplified Troop Deployment: Press M to open the map, then click on a barracks to rally your soldiers to a specific area. (Your soldiers will no longer be directly controlled by you.)

Troop Rallying: We've introduced two types of rallies: Normal Rally and Garrison Rally. Garrisoned soldiers won't move around, making it perfect for stationing your ranged units.

Summon Familiar: With a press of F, your Witch can now summon her familiar right to her side.
What's Next?
This covers all the exciting updates in this Demo refresh! The full version of the game is coming soon.

notes.title: New Big Update!
notes.content:
Visuals:
A brand new visual presentation! Still mysterious and dark, but with a redesigned look!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/f86751a255d040b05f8eca22e03ac8b0bda870cc.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]Story Background:
You, a pure-hearted young boy, are the only one who can command the witch Valentina. You must make her defend your village, which is on the verge of being torn apart by demons.

Some villagers are chosen and called Night Watchmen. They are sent to cages next to buildings to enhance the buildings' defense.

When a true crisis strikes, the witch Valentina can, without hesitation, sacrifice the Night Watchmen's lives to summon powerful energy and resolve the immediate danger.

So, will you sacrifice? Or will you protect? The fate of the villagers rests entirely in your hands.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/827557a92650a57c654faad5dcce2eb2ae784a3d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/3c74e005ea889b3c090cb300dbc9063beefe013e.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]Combat:
Carefully select active skills, passive skills, and sacrifice effects, then combine them with the abilities of buildings and soldiers on the battlefield, as well as the hidden abilities gained from deploying villagers.

Create your own unique combat style!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/d9990a69437ee883ff32feb9e7d7aad1554d050d.png"]
[hr][/hr]
We're thrilled to introduce so many significant changes in this version today.

We hope everyone who's interested will come and play the new demo, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist! See you next time!

notes.title: V0.1.1 Update!
notes.content:
- New:
  - Added some dialogue during battles
  - Left mouse button operation: Keyboard and mouse players can now use the left mouse button instead of the spacebar to perform actions such as "build", "upgrade", and "enter night".
  - Wave reminder: The current victory condition will be prompted each round
  - Enemy information: You can hover over enemies with the mouse in the pause menu to view their descriptions.

- Adjustments:
  - Fixed in-game stuttering: We have made significant optimizations, and in-game stuttering is now extremely rare.
  - Black Witch animation: Added a sudden stop animation when transitioning from running to stopping, making the movement more fluid.
  - Arch Demon: 
    - Animation is more natural
    - Increased size
    - The Arch Demon can be summoned when Chaos reaches 300.
Have fun!

notes.title: V0.1.0 Update!
notes.content:
New:
- Boss Battle: At the end of the battle, a red-cloaked witch named "Rossa" will appear as your opponent on the battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/6f814a999e1c4f190bf28f10d046807d32a353e2.jpg
  - Boss Rossa

  - Boss's unique health bar and minimap icon
- New Splash Screen:

Changes:

notes.title: New Update is coming!
notes.content:
Here are the specific changes:
Have fun playing! We've got plenty of goodies for you, so check them out!
【New】
Familiar Summoning Animation: 
"How could a familiar summoned by sacrificing a villager sneak onto the field? Nope! Let's fix that!" 
Now, when the chaos value reaches a certain threshold, familiars will make a cool entrance. (Even if they're off-screen, you'll feel their presence.)
【Changes】
Main Interface:
 "The scene on the main interface didn't match the story we wanted to tell, so we've completely redesigned it."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/0cb7ece804ce43e74d9027708a4ed62015c8b6b9.png
More realistic rendering of the witch The background clearly reflects the location where events take place (a dungeon) Modified the shop and game start entrances
Shop Interface: 
"In the Nuclear Fusion version, we said there would be a priest and a boy in this UI, and now they're here." 
The UI has been completely redrawn, and the way information is presented has been reconsidered. Added a priest and a boy. We can't reveal their story with the witch yet, but you might find clues in the articles we post on our social media accounts.
Added Female Villagers: 
"Two heads are better than one"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098466/73be460fdb872cabdadff99139d09318bbbf5b41.jpg
Female villagers will now appear in houses. The two villagers that appear when upgrading a house are not necessarily male and female.
【Other Adjustments】
Witch Altar: Adjusted the texture mapping.
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: V0.0.8 Update is coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
It's been over half a month since our last update. During this time, we've made adjustments to the keyboard and mouse controls, the tolerance system, and upgraded the rendering quality of the main base model. We hope you enjoy these changes!
Here are the specific changes:

【New】 
Sacrificing Villagers: 
"Sometimes, to gain power, sacrifices must be made. (Of course, the witch won't be the one sacrificed.)" 
- When the witch approaches a villager, press the prompt to squeeze the villager, just like the picture below!
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/f61069e8725438fc94b5538576e6b2b0a3a162e5.gif

【Modifications】 
Keyboard and Mouse Controls: 
"Are your fingers getting tangled trying to speed up, move around, control soldiers, and cast spells at the same time?"
- The witch's movement has been changed from keyboard to mouse. Right-click to automatically move to the target point. Hold down the right mouse button to continuously control the witch's movement.
-  Adjusted movement speed and removed running.
-  Skill keyboard keys: Changed from Q-E-R to Q-W-E
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/3ab6228c5e5b974efd52883dc191c9a684a672fd.gif
Tolerance System Major Adjustments: 
"After testing by our nuclear fusion player friends, we believe the tolerance system has been well-received by most people, but there is a need for adjustments in terms of performance!"
- Villagers have appeared in the village. 
- At night, villagers will flee back to their houses. If the houses are damaged, one villager will die. 
- If the witch cannot resist her thirst for blood, she can also actively squeeze the villagers, which will cause one villager to die but will increase her chaos value (increasing attack power and health, and summoning a small minion to assist when the threshold is reached). 
- Villager death will reduce tolerance. Tolerance will be restored at each sunrise based on the number of surviving villagers. (Perfect defense will not restore additional tolerance) 
Some minor adjustments:
- Witch Altar: Adjusted the rendering method. 
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45098466/7c53625d105a762731bd681627ea72d12072bb57.jpg
- Spawn Points: Added some air walls.
- Fixed some bugs.
